THE DARK MAZE

The maze has 15 floors. Every floor changes the environment, enemies and danger. Reach Floor 15 and face The Intruder.

15 floors • unique environments • monster variants • survival modes • final encounterRUN = one straight-line chase • SAFE AREAS = temporary protection

SELECT MODE

Choose how you want to enter the maze.

HOW YOU GOT IN

HOW TO PLAY

Survive the maze, find the keys, and reach the elevator. The deeper you go, the more dangerous the maze becomes.

CONTROLS

  • WASD — Move
  • Arrow Keys — Look / turn
  • SHIFT — Sprint
  • E — Pick up / use nearby item
  • F — Flashlight
  • R — Recharge flashlight with a battery
  • Q — Use medkit
  • Z — Use adrenaline
  • SPACE — Pulse stun / flash burst
  • V — Monster Finder
  • B — Key Finder
  • L — Lighter
  • ESC — Return to menu

THE MAP

  • The minimap shows explored maze walls, your position, the elevator, and active finder pings.

SURVIVAL

  • Manage your flashlight battery — darkness makes some monsters more dangerous. Items are more common than before, but Hard Mode makes threats faster.
  • Use the Monster Finder and Key Finder when you're lost.
  • Every 60 seconds, THE INTRUDER spawns directly behind you. You get a 3-second head start before it chases you.
  • The flashlight automatically turns off when its battery reaches zero. Batteries are intentionally common.
  • Some sections have working lights. Other sections stay dark.
  • Green-lit SAFE AREAS protect you from ordinary monsters.
  • RUN floors are straight corridors with every monster chasing you at once.
  • Find every required key before trying the elevator.

MONSTERS

  • The Stalker — hunts when it detects you.
  • Redmaw — becomes dangerous in darkness.
  • The Lurker — can reposition around you.
  • The Shade — hides in the dark.
  • The Howler — drains stamina with its howl.
  • The Mimic — moves when you're not looking.
  • The Blinker — teleports through the maze.
  • The Wardenling — becomes stronger while your flashlight is off.
  • The Grinder — charges when you sprint.
  • The Intruder — normally attacks from behind with a 3-second head start. On Floor 15, it becomes the final boss.
  • The Whisper — distorts your view.
  • The Watcher — moves when you look away.
  • The Hollow — drains flashlight power.
  • The Rusher — bursts forward in sudden charges.
  • Every 5 floors — RUN FOR YOUR LIFE begins with infinite stamina.
  • INSANE — much faster and denser threats.
  • RUN — starts the Floor RUN challenge.
